messages:
erin: Quick heads-up proposal: group Models + Jobs under a single 'Workloads' left-rail heading so we can add a persistent breadcrumb row and compact actions. Figma sketch attached.

sam: Fine with grouping. Two constraints: keep deep links stable and provide redirects for old /models/ URLs.

lee: Breadcrumb UX idea: show Org > Workloads > Type > Item. If space is tight collapse middle crumbs to '...'. Tooltip reveals full path.

mona: Accessibility: when a deeplink opens a collapsed group, focus should land on the item and we should announce "Models section expanded" with aria-live polite. Add visible skip link when rail is compact.

erin: For routing, prefer canonical path /app/:org/workloads/:kind/:id and server 301 from /app/:org/models/:id to the canonical one. Client should router.replace to avoid extra history entries.

sam: Minimal client middleware sketch:
```
if (path.startsWith('/app/' + org + '/models/')) {
  router.replace(path.replace('/models/', '/workloads/models/'))
}
```
Telemetry event: redirect.legacy.models.

lee: Micro-copy tweak: left-rail tooltip should read "Workloads — models, pipelines, jobs" not just "Workloads" to help discoverability. Also breadcrumb shortlabels: show a single-letter badge like "M" when compact.

mona: A11y checklist (high level): 1) focus management for expand via deeplink, 2) aria-live announcement, 3) aria-current on final breadcrumb, 4) visible focus ring on keyboard nav. I'll flesh out tests for NVDA/VO.

erin: Migration doc item: list legacy paths and curl tests. Example: curl -I https://app.redwood.com/app/org1/models/123 should return 301 Location: /app/org1/workloads/models/123. QA to validate.

sam: Agree. Also add e2e test that deep-link expands without changing scroll and only one history entry is created.

erin: OK let's proceed with a small beta. Action owners: @mona a11y checklist, @sam router+redirects, @lee copy/tooltips, @erin prototype. Will circle back in design review. :thumbsup:
